### Summary / 需求概述
Briefly describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.
简要描述您希望增加的功能或改进。

### Use Case / 适用场景
Explain when this feature is needed and what configuration or cross-plugin workflow problem it solves.
说明该功能在什么情况下会被使用，能解决哪些配置或跨插件协作问题。

### Design Proposal (Optional) / 方案设计（可选）
- Configuration schema or color-tag rules / 配置结构或色标规则
- Compatibility strategy with caller plugins / 与调用方插件的兼容策略
- Potential edge cases / 潜在边界情况
